information_boundary.privileged_projection_use: O arm only; remains in memory for root scoring and exact action-occurrence binding

population.blocking: same owner seed across O/C/E only identifies paired owner block; divergent arm histories are not common-random-number matched

arms.O: Online multi-decision privileged full-native-state terminal-rollout Oracle. At every eligible noncombat multichoice state evaluate each live legal action occurrence using pi_suffix continuations; select only under the frozen 2-SE rule, otherwise take the exact C fallback.
arms.C: Exact 0.80 ExpertNonCombatDriver expert_non_combat_v1 plus 0.20 uniform over live legal occurrences at each multichoice decision; same native Battle Search-v2@400.
arms.E: Pure ExpertNonCombatDriver expert_non_combat_v1 at every noncombat multichoice decision; same native Battle Search-v2@400.
arms.battle: same pinned native Battle Search-v2, 400 simulations, include all legal actions and potions, in all arms and suffixes
arms.suffix: exact 0.80 expert_non_combat_v1 plus 0.20 uniform over currently live legal occurrences; same pinned Battle Search-v2@400

oracle.eligible_decisions: every noncombat decision with more than one live legal action occurrence
oracle.selection: unique highest sample mean must exceed every alternative mean by more than 2*sqrt(sample_variance_best/n + sample_variance_alternative/n); otherwise abstain and take the C fallback
oracle.variance: unbiased sample variance with ddof=1 across the eight independent continuations per occurrence
oracle.tie_or_missing_candidate: fail closed; never map an absent, reordered, or ambiguous occurrence to a legal action
oracle.failure_policy: any missing, invalid, nonterminal, wrong-source, over-cap, or interrupted fixed continuation invalidates that owner attempt; no retry or result-subset analysis

estimand.primary: owner-paired difference in terminal floor O-C
estimand.secondary: owner-paired difference in terminal floor O-E
estimand.terminal_floor: native terminal floor_num; lower-level outcome is retained descriptively but not substituted for the registered primary endpoint
estimand.inference: 20,000 owner bootstrap resamples with replacement; nearest-rank 95% percentile interval at zero-based indices 499 and 19,499; resampling unit is the owner block
estimand.missing_owner_policy: no exclusions, replacement owners, partial arms, or retries; report incomplete phase without a primary estimate

measurements: terminal floor and native terminal outcome
noncombat decisions and nonfallback Oracle changes
early versus later noncombat decision timing
Oracle query count and candidate/sample count
charged CPU and wall latency by natural owner and continuation attempt
privileged exposure flags and locked source identities

decision_timing_summary.source: controller decision transition index and terminal completed_transitions count
decision_timing_summary.interpretation: within-run descriptive split only; not a treatment subgroup or inferential endpoint

stage0_cost_observation_for_planning_onl.warning: engineering extrapolations only: Gate C uses four fixed roots; debug root counts and marginal p95s are not a registered Stage 1 cohort or validated upper-tail prediction; formal execution still requires a separate CPU budget

stage0_interpretation.gate_c: 64/64 terminal suffixes; all four action-difference 95% CIs include zero; 2-SE rule abstained on all four roots; all 64 suffixes ended in loss; only two reached Act 2 and none reached Heart
stage0_interpretation.identified_quantity: Q(s_full,a;pi_suffix) conditional on a fixed native checkpoint/RNG with stochastic policy continuation; not Q(I_public,a) and not whole-game efficacy
stage0_interpretation.stage1_design_recommendation: NO-GO for activation absent independently precommitted technical evidence of useful nonfallback decision coverage; do not alter n=8 or 2-SE rule to force decisions

precision_note.interpretation: planning approximations only; actual paired outcome variance and power are unknown until separately authorized complete O/C/E outcomes exist
